title: Congruence of list disjunction
statement: Let $l$ be a list and let $p$ and $q$ be Boolean-valued predicates on its elements. If $p(a)=q(a)$ for every element $a$ of $l$, then the listwise disjunction of $p$ over $l$ equals the listwise disjunction of $q$ over $l$.
hypotheses_covered: The predicates agree on every element of the list
